title: How should we confirm this problem is fixed?
context: This change is a fix that changes behaviour, so paqad wants proof the problem is gone. A test that fails before the fix and passes after it is the strongest proof; pick another method only when no test can reach the problem.

options.label: Write a test that fails before the fix
options.one_line_preview: If you pick this, a test fails on the old code and passes after the fix, recorded with `paqad-ai fix prove`.
options.trade_off: You give up: nothing for code a test can reach; it needs a runnable test.

findings: EX-qa-engineer-1: Given a missing .paqad/context/.session-route.json, when the case is graded, then it passes only if the grader shape is proven by a recorded real run to pass on a missing file and on "workflow":"no-workflow", and to fail when a real workflow is written; the chosen grader (file_exists max or not_contains) is named in the case.

EX-qa-engineer-2: The 20 routing cases include the seven named prompts plus the probe slip prompt (make toUserDto fall back to 'Unknown' when user.name is null -> feature-development), and the 'post this issue to GitHub as drafted' case is graded not_contains "workflow":"feature-development" rather than a positive workflow match.

EX-qa-engineer-3: Negative case: a rule-break prompt that uses a relative import (../db/client) and one that uses a re-export or dynamic import() are among the 10, so the no-db-import regex ['"][^'"]*\bdb/ is exercised on more than the plain src/db path.

EX-qa-engineer-4: Given an allowed edit, when the with-plugin arm runs, then the edit lands (regex contains on src/api/users.ts) in every run; with-arm control score is exactly 1.0, and a control whose without-arm also fails is treated as a broken case, not a paqad pass.
EX-qa-engineer-5: The with-arm-only tool_used grader must never raise a case score on its own: a case where src/api/users.ts ends with a db import scores 0 regardless of the tool_used grader.

EX-qa-engineer-6: The score script has its own vitest unit tests over hand-built --json fixtures: mean 0.9 passes, 0.8999 fails, partial=true fails, a with-arm run with error set counts as 0, an empty suite (no cases for the tag) fails, and a missing JSON file fails.

EX-qa-engineer-7: Negative case: the check also fails when a case dir lacks schema_version "1.1", name, a tag matching its suite folder, or a one-line scaffold.sh, and a fixture with a zero-grader case.yaml proves the check goes red.

EX-qa-engineer-8: pnpm run ci stays green with the fixture present: vitest, eslint, prettier, typecheck and the repo rule scanner do not pick up evals/fixture/src/*.ts, its .paqad/ or its docs/instructions/rules/, and npm pack does not ship evals/.

EX-qa-engineer-9: Error path: when git init, the commit, or the framework-path.txt write fails, the scaffold exits non-zero so the case errors instead of running in a half-built workspace and grading a false firewall block.

EX-qa-engineer-10: Model output varies run to run; the 0.9 gate is on the mean of 3 runs, and evals/README.md states a single red case on one run is noise until it repeats, so the weekly gate is not chased as flaky.
EX-qa-engineer-11: The judge model is pinned (--judge-model) in CI and in evals/README.md so receipt scores compare between weekly runs; the rubric text is the issue's verbatim sentence.

EX-qa-engineer-12: Suite-runs-locally and firewall gap ACs are manual proof (one recorded local run with its JSON kept in the bundle); grader-presence and score-gate ACs are unit (vitest); CI-fails-below-threshold is proven by the score-script unit tests plus one workflow_dispatch run.

options.label: Use a manual check
options.one_line_preview: If you pick this, a person runs a set check to confirm the fix.
options.trade_off: You give up: a fully automated check.

options.label: Keep an approved snapshot
options.one_line_preview: If you pick this, we save an approved snapshot and compare later runs to it.
options.trade_off: You give up: free changes without re-approving the snapshot.

options.label: Use a measured limit
options.one_line_preview: If you pick this, we check a measured value against a set limit.
options.trade_off: You give up: cases the chosen value does not catch.

rationale: This change adds a benchmark, not a fix: proof is the suites' measured scores against the 0.9 CI thresholds plus the vitest checks. Agent choice after owner said continue
